after.zh: 采样这一步没法求导：每次重抽，训练分不清结果变好是因为改了 μ、σ 还是运气。把它写成 z = μ + σ·ε，随机全部来自输入 ε，z 对 μ、σ 就只是乘和加，梯度清清楚楚。这叫重参数化，VAE 的编码器就是这样训练的。
after.en: You cannot differentiate through the sampling step: with a fresh draw each time, training cannot tell whether a better result came from changing μ and σ or from luck. Write it as z = μ + σ·ε instead: all the randomness comes from the input ε, z is just a multiply and an add of μ and σ, and the gradient is perfectly clear. This is called reparameterization, and it is how a VAE's encoder is trained.

t.zh: <level-ref to="8-1"></level-ref>的解码器能把两个数画成斑点。要是这两个数随机抽，就能画出没见过的斑点，这就是生成。随机不是乱来：数从正态分布里抽，大多落在中心 μ 附近，σ 越大越散。
t.en: The decoder from <level-ref to="8-1"></level-ref> can turn two numbers into a blob. If those two numbers are drawn at random, it can draw blobs it has never seen: that is generation. Random does not mean anything goes: the numbers are drawn from a normal distribution, so most land near the centre μ, and the larger σ is, the more they spread out.

t.zh: 训练就是把参数拧一点，看结果变好还是变坏，再往好的方向调；能算出该往哪拧，叫求导。可 μ、σ 和画出的图之间夹着一步随机抽样，这种调法还行得通吗？
t.en: Training means nudging the parameters a little, seeing whether the result gets better or worse, and adjusting in the better direction; working out which way to nudge is called differentiating. But there is a random sampling step between μ, σ and the image that gets drawn. Can this kind of adjustment still work?

t.zh: 这一关的元件：μ、σ 各是两个可训练的数；「采样」每算一次都抽一个新的随机数；<part-ref to="dg-decoder"></part-ref>把两个数画成斑点，一个管左右，一个管上下。
t.en: The parts in this level: μ and σ are each two trainable numbers; "Sample" draws a fresh random number every time it runs; <part-ref to="dg-decoder"></part-ref> turns two numbers into a blob, one controlling left-right and the other up-down.

t.zh: 老师画每张图用的随机数 ε，测试都给了你。你要学出老师的 μ 和 σ，用同样的 ε 画出同样的斑点。Stable Diffusion 里压缩、还原图的部分，训练时也要过这一关。
t.en: The tests give you the random numbers ε the teacher used to draw each image. You must learn the teacher's μ and σ so that the same ε draws the same blob. The part of Stable Diffusion that compresses and restores images has to clear this same hurdle in training.

caption.zh: 一组噪声 ε → 老师用它画出的斑点
caption.en: A set of noise ε → the blob the teacher drew with it

brief.zh: 老师用每组的噪声 ε 画出了右边的斑点（z 从 N(μ, σ²) 中采样）。学出 μ 和 σ，用同样的 ε 画出同样的图。
brief.en: The teacher drew the blob on the right from each set's noise ε (z sampled from N(μ, σ²)). Learn μ and σ, and draw the same image from the same ε.

hint.zh: 采样器每算一次都换一个随机数，训练看到的只是噪声。老师用的那组 ε 就在输入里。
hint.en: The sampler draws a new random number every time it runs, so all training sees is noise. The teacher's ε is right there in the input.
